note.text: Pointer only: this resource holds metadata, not pixels. The image is the entry in the ARex manifest arex-manifest-postop. By the project's convention (decision F25) the second identifier repeats the manifest's transaction-context business identifier (urn:ohia:referral-id|REF-2026-UC07-001); by the owner's option B this is the same value as the interaction-1 radiograph manifest, so the search returns both manifests (see the manifest's note). ASSUMPTION: the narrative gives no time for the post-operative radiograph, so only the date is recorded. DICOM UIDs are synthetic (2.25.*) and no DICOM object exists behind them.
